data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'virgo', meaning 'maiden' or 'virgin'. This name was commonly given to girls in the Roman Empire who were unmarried and chaste. In Christian tradition, the Virgin Mary is the most famous bearer of this name. The name Virgina carries the meaning “Maiden, virgin” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Virgina usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden, virgin and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Παρθένος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Virgina in the Greek language is written as Παρθένος (Parthenos). The meaning of the name is 'virgin'. In ancient Greek culture, Parthenos was a title given to goddesses who were considered virginal or chaste. The long meaning of the name reflects its significance as a symbol of purity, innocence, and dedication to the divine.
